traits.description: The dark eye has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Gaze of Shadows
traits.description: When a creature that can see the dark eye's eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the dark eye, the dark eye can force it to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw if the dark eye isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the dark eye until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the dark eye in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

traits.name: Whispers of Shadow (Recharge 5–6)
traits.description: The dark voice speaks in Umbral, whispering of what it sees beyond the dark. The area within 30 feet of the dark voice becomes dimly lit until the end of the dark voice's next turn. Only sunlight can illuminate the area brightly during this time. Each non-dark folk creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage and be frightened until the start of its next turn.

subraces.description: The most powerful of the dark folk, a dark voice sacrifices both eyes to the truth lurking in the shadows.

description: This pale-skinned humanoid is swathed in dark robes. Beneath its hood, its face is a grotesque mask. Smooth, featureless flesh is where one eye would be; the existing eye is a black pit that swallows both light and hope.

Gaze of Shadows.notes: Can force a creature within 30 ft to make a DC 13 Wisdom save or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage and be incapacitated until start of its next turn. Half damage on success. Creature can avert eyes to avoid.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: While in sunlight, has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Darksight.notes: Magical darkness doesn't impede the dark folk's darkvision.

Pack Tactics.notes: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 ft of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

name: Ratfolk

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.description: The ratfolk mercenary can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The ratfolk has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratfolk's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Swim Speed
traits.description: Speed 25 ft., swim 10 ft.

description: Ratfolk are small humanoids with a knack for stealth and pack tactics, often found in mercenary or warlock roles. They have darkvision and a natural nimbleness that allows them to move through larger creatures' spaces.

Nimbleness.notes: Can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature.

Pack Tactics.notes: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one ally is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

name: Kapi

traits.name: Nimble Feet
traits.description: The kapi can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail
traits.description: The kapi can use its tail to pick up or hold a small object that isn't being worn or carried. It can use its tail to interact with objects, leaving its hands free to wield weapons or carry heavier objects. The kapi can't use its tail to wield a weapon but can use it to trip an opponent (see below).

description: Kapi are medium humanoid simians from tropical jungles, where they make their homes in treetop villages. They are curious, playful tricksters with prehensile tails.

Nimble Feet.notes: Can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

Prehensile Tail.notes: Can use tail to pick up or hold small objects not worn/carried, interact with objects, and trip opponents. Cannot wield weapons with tail.

name: Vanara

traits.name: Distract
traits.description: As a bonus action, the vanara can use its tail to distract an opponent within 5 feet of it by pulling on an arm, tossing dirt in the target’s face, or some other method of interfering. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have disadvantage on all attacks against the vanara until the vanara’s next turn.

traits.name: Quadrupedal Dash
traits.description: As a bonus action, the vanara can move up to 80 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. It can’t use this trait if it is wielding a weapon or holding an object weighing more than 10 lbs.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: The vanara’s long jump is 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

description: Vanaras are a contemplative race that dwells in forests or along coastlines, living in tribes or clans. They are medium humanoids with simian features, often dressing only in short pants or waist wraps and a turban.

Distract.notes: As a bonus action, can force a target within 5 ft to make DC 13 Dex save or have disadvantage on attacks against the vanara until its next turn.

Quadrupedal Dash.notes: As a bonus action, can move up to 80 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Cannot use if wielding a weapon or holding an object weighing more than 10 lbs.

Standing Leap.notes: Long jump is 30 feet and high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

name: Eladrin

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.description: You can cast the misty step spell once using this trait. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.

description: Creatures of magic with strong ties to nature, eladrin live in the twilight realm of the Feywild. Their cities sometimes cross over to the Material Plane, appearing briefly in mountain valleys or deep forest glades before fading back into the Feywild.

Fey Step.notes: You can cast the misty step spell once per short or long rest.

name: Aasimar

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Aasimar mature at the same rate as humans but live a few years longer.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Due to their celestial heritage, aasimar are often good. However, some aasimar fall into evil, rejecting their heritage.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Aasimar are built like well-proportioned humans. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your celestial heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Celestial Legacy
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the lesser restoration spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Once you reach 5th level, you can cast the daylight spell once with this trait as a 3rd-level spell, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Celestial.

description: Aasimar are celestial-touched humanoids, often with a radiant or angelic appearance, built like well-proportioned humans.

Celestial Legacy.notes: Knows the light cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast lesser restoration once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast daylight (3rd-level) once per long rest. Spellcasting ability: Charisma.

Languages.notes: Languages: Common, Celestial

name: Custom Lineage
languages: One other language appropriate for your character

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: One ability score of your choice increases by 2.

traits.name: Feat
traits.description: You gain one feat of your choice for which you qualify.

traits.name: Variable Trait
traits.description: You gain one of the following options of your choice: (a) darkvision with a range of 60 feet or (b) proficiency in one skill of your choice.

description: Instead of choosing one of the game's races for your character at 1st level, you can use the following traits to represent your character's lineage, giving you full control over how your character's origin shaped them.

Ability Score Increase.notes: One ability score of your choice increases by 2.

Feat.notes: You gain one feat of your choice for which you qualify.

Variable Trait.notes: You gain one of the following options of your choice: (a) darkvision with a range of 60 feet or (b) proficiency in one skill of your choice.

name: Bearfolk

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your powerful jaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits, you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: Your hide is thick and tough, granting you a natural AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Ursine Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics and Perception skills.

subraces.name: Shadowborn
subraces.description: A subrace of bearfolk has arisen in the Shadow Realm: the shadowborn.

description: Bearfolk can reach a height of over 7 feet, possessing thick, muscular builds.

Bite.notes: Natural weapon: bite (1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage, counts as unarmed strike).

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight.

name: Shadowborn Bearfolk

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: Your powerful jaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits, you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: Your hide is thick and tough, granting you a natural AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Ursine Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics and Perception skills.

traits.name: Cloak of Night
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

description: Shadowborn bearfolk are cubs born in the Shadow Realm with a proclivity for the darkness, marked by gray coats from infancy and sometimes possessing strangely arcane black markings.

Bite.notes: Your powerful jaws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits, you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Cloak of Night.notes: While in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

name: Darakhul

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Hunger for Flesh
traits.description: You must consume 1 pound of raw meat each day or suffer the effects of starvation. If you go 24 hours without such a meal, you gain one level of exhaustion. While you have any levels of exhaustion from this trait, you can't regain hit points or remove levels of exhaustion until you spend at least 1 hour consuming 10 pounds of raw meat.

traits.name: Imperfect Undeath
traits.description: You transitioned into undeath, but your transition was imperfect. Though you are a humanoid, you are susceptible to effects that target undead. You can regain hit points from spells like cure wounds, but you can also be affected by game effects that specifically target undead, such as a cleric's Turn Undead feature. Game effects that raise a creature from the dead work on you as normal, but they return you to life as a darakhul. A true resurrection or wish spell can restore you to life as a fully living member of your original race.

traits.name: Powerful Jaw
traits.description: Your heavy jaw is powerful enough to crush bones to powder. Your bite is a natural melee weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, your bite deals piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Undead Resilience
traits.description: You are infused with the dark energy of undeath, which frees you from some frailties that plague most creatures. You have resistance to necrotic damage and poison damage, you are immune to disease, and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or poisoned. When you finish a short rest, you can reduce your exhaustion level by 1, provided you have ingested at least 1 pound of raw meat in the last 24 hours (see Hunger for Flesh feature).

traits.name: Undead Vitality
traits.description: You don't need to breathe, and you don't sleep the way most creatures do. Instead, you enter a dormant state that resembles death, remaining semiconscious, for 6 hours a day. While dormant, you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

subraces.name: Bearfolk Heritage

traits.name: Jaws of Death
traits.description: Your powerful jaws serve you well as a darakhul. When you use your bite attack to make an unarmed strike, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.description: Your tenacity in life has followed you into undeath. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

subraces.description: Your darakhul character was a bearfolk before transforming into a darakhul. While your allegiance has changed, your mission to create order amid the darkness has not. The strength and tenacity of the darakhul are comfortingly familiar.

subraces.name: Shadow Goblin Heritage

traits.name: Dark Deed
traits.description: Your fascination with humor has not gone away, but you've had to adopt more macabre tactics. As an action, you can perform a combination of rude gestures and sounds to attempt to scare one creature you can see within 30 feet. If the target can see and hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of its turn. The DC for this saving throw is equal to 10 plus your Charisma modifier.

subraces.description: Your darakhul character was a shadow goblin before transforming into a darakhul.

description: Darakhul are undead creatures transformed from various mortal races, retaining some traits of their former lives while gaining necrotic powers.

Hunger for Flesh.notes: Must consume 1 pound of raw meat daily or suffer starvation. After 24 hours without, gain 1 level of exhaustion. While exhausted from this trait, cannot regain hit points or remove exhaustion until consuming 10 pounds of raw meat over 1 hour.

Imperfect Undeath.notes: Counts as humanoid but is susceptible to effects targeting undead (e.g., Turn Undead). Can be healed by cure wounds. Resurrection spells return you as a darakhul; true resurrection or wish can restore original race.

Powerful Jaw.notes: Bite is a natural melee weapon for unarmed strikes, dealing 1d4 + Strength modifier piercing damage instead of normal bludgeoning.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, target, or perceived object is in direct sunlight.

Undead Resilience.notes: After a short rest, can reduce exhaustion by 1 if ingested at least 1 pound of raw meat in last 24 hours.

Undead Vitality.notes: Does not need to breathe. Enters a dormant state for 6 hours (disadvantage on Perception checks) instead of sleep, gaining same benefit as 8 hours of sleep.

name: Shadow Fey

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Although they have a malevolent reputation, the shadow fey are not inherently evil. They tend toward chaotic neutral, though every variation exists.

traits.name: Shadow Fey Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the rapier, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Path of Shadows
traits.description: When in darkness, dim light, or a shadow large enough to cover your body, you can cast the misty step spell. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in bright sunlight.

traits.name: Traveler in Darkness
traits.description: You have advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check to learn about a particular shadow road and how it functions.

traits.name: Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

subraces.name: Lunar Elf

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Although they have a malevolent reputation, the shadow fey are not inherently evil. They tend toward chaotic neutral, though every variation exists.

traits.name: Luminous
traits.description: You emit bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. You can choose to suppress this effect to only dim light in a 15-foot radius, to suppress it completely, or to activate it at any time without expending an action. (This effect has a level equal to your proficiency bonus, and if any of its area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of the same level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.)

traits.name: Moon Child
traits.description: When in darkness, dim light, or a shadow large enough to cover your body, you can cast the moonbeam spell. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

traits.name: Shadow Fey Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the rapier, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in sunlight.

traits.name: Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

subraces.description: Lunar elves are an offshoot of shadow fey and are quite rare, and their births are typically regarded as an auspicious omen. If the origin of the shadow fey is mysterious, then that of the lunar elves is even more so, though many lunar elves have been recently drawn toward the Moonlit King, seeking out this exiled sovereign. Always born under the light of the full moons, these shadow fey seem saturated with its light. Lunar elves are not automatically ostracized from the shadow fey courts, but many prefer to take up duties that remove themselves from the watchful eyes of the shadow fey nobles: serving as an emissary to the Moonlit Glades, taking up residence in the Starry Court, or training to hunt the beasts of the region is often preferable to the suspicious gaze of the Queen of Night and Magic.

description: Shadow fey have skin color tending toward alabaster white, ebon black, or subtle grays, and many have horns that range widely in size and shape.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Charisma score increases by 1.

Path of Shadows.notes: Can cast misty step in darkness/dim light/shadow, uses per day equal to Charisma modifier (min 1), regains on long rest. Charisma is spellcasting ability.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight when in bright sunlight.

Traveler in Darkness.notes: Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to learn about shadow roads.

Language.notes: Speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

name: Sable Elf

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your Dexterity decreases by 1.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Due to their exiled status, sable elves have lost attachment to many of the values traditionally held by elves. Centuries of solitude have pushed the remaining sable elves in different directions, and a variety of alignments are found within their ranks.

traits.name: Blood Affinity
traits.description: Choose a school of magic you have a natural affinity for. You learn a cantrip of your choice from that school. When you reach 3rd level, choose a 1st-level spell from the same school, and when you reach 5th level, choose a 3rd-level spell from the same school. You learn these spells and can cast them at their lowest level. Once you cast one of these spells, you must finish a long rest before you can cast the spell again using this feature. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence.

traits.name: Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

description: Sable elves are dark-eyed, often either red-haired or raven-haired, and silver-skinned. They have tall, willowy frames, similar to other elves.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Intelligence score increases by 2, Dexterity decreases by 1.

Blood Affinity.notes: Choose a school of magic. Learn one cantrip from that school. At 3rd level, learn one 1st-level spell from that school; at 5th level, learn one 3rd-level spell from that school. Spells can be cast once per long rest at lowest level. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

Language.notes: Can speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

name: Shadow Goblin

traits.name: Quick Wit
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Deception and Insight skills.

traits.name: Shadow Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Stink Eye
traits.description: As an action, you can perform a combination of rude gestures and sounds to distract one creature you can see within 30 feet. If the target can hear and see you, it must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma ability modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failure, it has disadvantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Unseelie Blessing
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

description: Shadow goblins are blue- or purple-skinned with bright orange or yellow eyes, evolved to thrive in the Shadow Realm as servitors and allies of the shadow fey.

Shadow Camouflage.notes: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in dim light or darkness.

Stink Eye.notes: As an action, force a creature within 30 ft that can see and hear you to make a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + Cha mod + prof bonus). On failure, it has disadvantage on the next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw before the start of your next turn.

Sunlight Sensitivity.notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target, or the thing you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

Unseelie Blessing.notes: Magic can't put you to sleep (included in condition_immune as 'Sleep').

name: Umbral Human

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: You may choose one score to increase by 2 and a different score to increase by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Your natural aging process slows and becomes similar to that of an elf or shadow fey.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Umbral humans have often walked a troubling path to become what they are. This tends to push umbral humans toward neutral or chaotic alignments, but all variations exist.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Dark Infusion
traits.description: You have resistance to cold damage.

traits.name: Fade Away
traits.description: While standing perfectly still, you can use an action to become invisible. You become visible again if you move or take an action. You can use this feature a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Umbral.

traits.name: Subtypes
traits.description: The generational infusion of shadow manifests itself in different ways, but two especially noteworthy categories of umbral humans exist: changelings and the gifted. Choose one of the two subraces presented below.

subraces.name: Changeling
subraces.description: Changelings are the natural result of humans adapting to a life in the shadows over multiple generations. Originally, humans were stolen from the mortal lands to serve their shadow fey masters—or just on a whim—and many more humans simply got lost on a shadow road or abandoned and ultimately became stranded in the Shadow Realm. And that new life in shadows must ultimately change a mortal.

description: Umbral humans are humans transformed by exposure to shadow over generations, with skin tending toward alabaster white, ebon black, or subtle grays, and some even grow rudimentary horns like shadow fey.

Ability Score Increase.notes: You may choose one score to increase by 2 and a different score to increase by 1.

Age.notes: Your natural aging process slows and becomes similar to that of an elf or shadow fey.

Alignment.notes: Umbral humans have often walked a troubling path to become what they are. This tends to push umbral humans toward neutral or chaotic alignments, but all variations exist.

Fade Away.notes: While standing perfectly still, you can use an action to become invisible. You become visible again if you move or take an action. You can use this feature a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus.

Language.notes: You can speak, read, and write Common and Umbral.

Subtypes.notes: The generational infusion of shadow manifests itself in different ways, but two especially noteworthy categories of umbral humans exist: changelings and the gifted. Choose one of the two subraces presented below.

name: Changeling Umbral Human

traits.name: Cover Story
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Deception or Persuasion skill.

traits.name: Shadow Glamour
traits.description: You can use an action to cast the disguise self spell at will.

description: Changeling Umbral Humans resemble their cousins from the mortal lands but with the hallmarks of a life in the shadows, with skin color tending toward alabaster white, ebon black, or subtle grays, and some have even grown rudimentary horns.

Shadow Glamour.notes: Can use an action to cast disguise self at will.

name: Gifted Umbral Folk

traits.name: Cursed Infusion
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Shadow Gift
traits.description:
You struck a bargain with a shadow fey to receive a gift, but it came at a terrible price. Choose one of the options below to determine the benefit and penalty you possess (or discuss other options with your GM):
•	 You become proficient in one skill of your choice and always roll ability checks made with that skill at advantage. Choose a second skill, and always roll ability checks made with that skill at disadvantage.
•	 You no longer need to eat or breathe to survive and require only 4 hours for a long rest. Gain one level of exhaustion. This level of exhaustion cannot be removed by any means magical or non-magical.
•	 Cut your current base movement speed in half. Gain a fly, swim, or climb speed equal to your newly halved base movement speed.
•	 Increase one of your ability scores by 6 (up to 20). Reduce two different ability scores by 2.
•	 Each day at dawn, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution score. You are no longer able to spend hit dice to heal during short rests.

description: Gifted Umbral Folk are humans transformed by drinking too deeply of shadows, often initiated by shadow fey or other dark powers, and can vary widely in appearance from normal humans to shadow fey, sometimes with minor or dramatic changes like tails, hooves, or vestigial wings.

Shadow Gift.notes: Choose one of the following mechanical packages: (1) Proficiency in one skill of choice (always at advantage) and a second skill of choice (always at disadvantage). (2) No need to eat/breathe, long rest requires 4 hours, gain 1 permanent level of exhaustion. (3) Base movement speed halved; gain fly, swim, or climb speed equal to halved base speed. (4) Increase one ability score by 6 (max 20), reduce two different ability scores by 2. (5) Each dawn gain temporary HP equal to Constitution score; cannot spend Hit Dice during short rests.

name: Quickstep

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Quicksteps have remarkably short lifespans compared to other fey. Quicksteps mature around 10 years and live up to 50 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Due to their association with the shadow fey and their legendary love of competitions, quicksteps have dark reputations, but they are rarely of evil alignment. Many quicksteps have a mischievous, even impetuous, streak that pushes them toward chaotic or neutral alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 50 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Acrobatics and Sleight of Hand skills.

traits.name: Startling Speed
traits.description: Your movements are so swift that you are almost invisible when in motion. If you move at least 10 feet on your turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn. This feature does not function if you are incapacitated or restrained. You can use this ability a number of rounds per day equal to your level.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

description: Quicksteps are small fey with a natural affinity for speed, often found in the fey courts, where they excel at sabotage and dueling. They have a fondness for finery and feel at home amid the riches of court life.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity score increases by 2, Charisma score increases by 1.

Age.notes: Mature around 10 years, live up to 50 years.

Alignment.notes: Often mischievous, chaotic or neutral alignments, rarely evil.

Darkvision.notes: Can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

Startling Speed.notes: If you move at least 10 feet on your turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn. Does not function if incapacitated or restrained. Usable a number of rounds per day equal to your level.

Languages.notes: Speak, read, and write Elvish and Umbral.

name: Ratatosk

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, but your Strength score decreases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Ratatosk reach adulthood at age 10 and, due to their celestial nature, live up to 180 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Ever curious and delighting in unpredictability, ekorre ratatosks gravitate toward chaotic alignments as they view laws as vague suggestions at best. The tradvakt tend to be slightly more focused and lawful in their thinking. Both groups tend toward good, placing value on doing the right thing, though some individuals lean more toward their darker impulses.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet, and you have a climb speed of 10 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Grounded Celestial
traits.description: You are descended from celestials, but you are strongly attuned to the mortal world. Though you are a humanoid, you are still susceptible to effects that target celestials.

traits.name: Sharp Tusks
traits.description: Your sharp tusks are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal 1 piercing damage plus 1d4 psychic damage.

traits.name: Telepathic
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see, provided the creature is within a number of feet of you equal to 10 times your level. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can understand, read, and write Celestial and Common, but you speak via Telepathy.

subraces.name: Ekorre (Clever Tusk)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Either your Intelligence or Charisma score increases by 1.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Ekorre ratatosks are around 1-1/2 feet tall and weigh between 20 and 50 pounds. Your size is Tiny.

traits.name: Blessing of Yggdrasil
traits.description: You are attuned to the World Tree and can tap into its power. You know the message and vicious mockery cantrips. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the mirror image spell with this trait. Once you cast a non-cantrip spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Diminutive Weapons
traits.description: You can wield weapons with the light or finesse properties normally. You have disadvantage on attack rolls with other weapons, unable to use them effectively due to your Tiny size, and they are treated as two-handed weapons. You can't use heavy weapons at all. A weapon specifically designed for ratatosks (or for other Tiny creatures at the GM's discretion) are treated normally.

subraces.description: The ekorre are the image most have in mind when discussing ratatosks. Superficially similar to squirrels, they have sleek fur, often in shades of red and brown, and tiny tusks. These celestials dwell upon Yggdrasil and all its branches. Clever, egotistical, and endlessly curious, the ekorre carry messages across the planes, sharing information from individual to individual in a never-ending gossip network.

subraces.name: Tradvakt (Tree Protector)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 1.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: A typical tradvakt stands between 2 and 3 feet tall, weighing from 60 to 100 pounds. Some massive ratatosk warlords reach a towering 3-1/2 feet. Your size is Small.

traits.name: War Chatter
traits.description: Your constant chittering distracts your opponents. As a bonus action, a non-ratatosk creature within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on its attack rolls until the start of your next turn. The DC of the save equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution bonus. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subraces.description: The tradvakt, also called ratatosk warlords, believe themselves to be the guardians and protectors of Yggdrasil and the branches of the World Tree. Larger than their ekorre cousins, the tradvakt train from a young age to master weapons and battle tactics. They act to maintain order in their communities and stamp out dangers that threaten those settlements.

description: Resembling squirrels with sleek fur and small tusks, ratatosks are insatiable tricksters who form close matriarchal familial units called drays within larger communities called scurries.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity increases by 2, Strength decreases by 2.

Age.notes: Reach adulthood at age 10, live up to 180 years.

Alignment.notes: Tend toward chaotic good, with some lawful tendencies for tradvakt.

Speed.notes: Also has a climb speed of 10 feet.

Grounded Celestial.notes: Humanoid type, but susceptible to effects that target celestials.

Sharp Tusks.notes: Natural weapon: unarmed strike deals 1 piercing + 1d4 psychic damage.

Telepathic.notes: Can speak telepathically to any visible creature within 10 × level feet; no shared language needed, but target must understand at least one language.

Languages.notes: Understands Celestial and Common, but speaks via Telepathy.

name: Spiritfarer Erina

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and you can choose to increase either your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1. (This trait replaces the base erina's Ability Score Increase trait.)

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Erina reach maturity around 15 years and can live up to 60 years, though some erina burrow elders have memories of events that suggest erina can live much longer.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Spiritfarer erina are good-hearted and extremely social creatures with an oversized sense of wonder. They have a difficult time adapting to the laws of other peoples, but they cherish the bonds of their communities. They tend more toward neutral and lawful alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Erina average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 50 pounds. Your size is Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Digger
traits.description: You have a burrow speed of 20 feet, but you can use it to only move through earth and sand, not mud, ice, or rock.

traits.name: Quills
traits.description: Your spines are longer and more potent than other erinas. Whenever you make a successful melee attack against a target within 5 feet of you, that target takes an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage. (This trait replaces the base erina's Spines trait.)

traits.name: Sharp Instincts
traits.description: You can't be surprised, except when incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep. (This replaces the base erina's Keen Senses trait.)

traits.name: Spirit Tongue
traits.description: You have an innate knack for speaking to the spirit world. You know the message cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the charm person spell with this trait (targeting only undead creatures), and starting at 5th level, you can cast the enthrall spell with it. Once you cast a non‑cantrip spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak Erina and Umbral and either Common, Elvish, or Sylvan.

description: The erina are a race of bipedal folk that resemble hedgehogs. Spiritfarer erinas are a subrace of erina, whose ancestors were forever changed by the Shadow Realm, setting them apart from most other erina.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Wisdom +2, choose Dexterity or Charisma +1.

Age.notes: Flavor only: reach maturity ~15 years, live up to 60+ years.

Alignment.notes: Flavor only: tend toward neutral and lawful alignments.

Digger.notes: Burrow speed 20 ft. (only through earth and sand, not mud, ice, or rock).

Quills.notes: On a successful melee attack within 5 ft., deal an additional 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

Sharp Instincts.notes: Cannot be surprised except when incapacitated by something other than nonmagical sleep.

Spirit Tongue.notes: Knows message cantrip. At 3rd level: charm person (undead only) 1/long rest. At 5th level: enthrall 1/long rest. Spellcasting ability: Wisdom.

Languages.notes: Speak Erina, Umbral, and one of Common, Elvish, or Sylvan.

name: Erina (Spiritfarer)

description: Spiritfarer erina are good-hearted and extremely social creatures with an oversized sense of wonder, adapted to the Shadow Realm.

Age.notes: Flavor only: reach maturity ~15, live up to 60 years.

Spirit Tongue.notes: Knows message cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast charm person (undead only) once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast enthrall once per long rest. Spellcasting ability: Wisdom.

name: Stygian Shade

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1. (This trait replaces the base shade's Ability Score Increase trait.)

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Shades appear as the age they were when they died. They potentially have no limit to their lifespan, but realistically, ancient shades grow weary and lose their will to hold onto reality, fading away near 750 years old or so.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Stygian shades come from all walks of life but tend toward neutrality. Those that can't recover their memories or grow to resent their condition often drift toward evil alignments.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Choose whether you are Small or Medium sized. (This trait replaces the base shade's Size trait.)

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Death Mask
traits.description: As an action, you can strip away your veneer of life and expose your true spectral face. All non-undead creatures within 30 feet that can see you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to your Death Mask for the next 24 hours. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier. (This trait replaces the base shade's Life Drain trait.)

traits.name: Ghostly Flesh
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use your action to dissolve your physical body into the ephemeral stuff of spirits. You become translucent and devoid of color, and the air around you grows cold. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, you have a flying speed of 30 feet with the ability to hover, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't made with silvered weapons. In addition, you have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple or against being restrained, and you can move through creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, you take 1d10 force damage. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Imperfect Undeath
traits.description: You are a humanoid, but your partial transition into undeath makes you susceptible to effects that target undead. Though you can regain hit points from spells like cure wounds, you can also be affected by effects that specifically target undead, such as a cleric's Turn Undead feature. Effects that raise a creature from the dead work on you as normal, but they return you to life as a shade. A true resurrection or wish spell can restore you to life as a fully living member of your original race.

traits.name: Mysterious Origin
traits.description:
Stygian shades are born with almost no memory of their former lives but have an innate desire to remember who they are. When you create your stygian shade, decide which one of these questions you know the answer to. The rest are questions you seek to answer:
•  What is your name?
•  Where are you from?
•  Who were the people you loved most?
•  How did you die?
•  What unfinished business has caused you to rise as a shade?
(This replaces the base shade's Living Origin trait.)

traits.name: Spectral Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease, and you have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Umbral and one other language of your choice.

description: Stygian shades are shades from the Shadow Realm who lack most of their memories and are driven to find what was lost. They appear as ghosts, often congregating in the city of Soriglass.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Constitution score increases by 2, and one other ability score of your choice increases by 1.

Death Mask.notes: Action to expose spectral face; non-undead creatures within 30 ft must make DC 13 Wis save or be frightened for 1 minute. Repeat save each turn. Usable Con mod times per day.

Ghostly Flesh.notes: Starting at 3rd level. Action to transform for 1 minute. Gains flying speed 30 ft (hover). Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical non-silvered attacks. Advantage on grapple escape checks/saves vs restrained. Can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain; takes 1d10 force if ending turn inside object. Once per long rest.

Imperfect Undeath.notes: Humanoid type but susceptible to effects targeting undead (e.g., Turn Undead). Can be healed by cure wounds. Resurrection returns as shade; true resurrection/wish restores original race.

Mysterious Origin.notes: Flavor trait; choose one known memory question from list.

Spectral Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

Languages.notes: Speak, read, write Umbral and one other language.

name: Sublime Ravenfolk

traits.name: Constant Tune
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. (This trait replaces the base ravenfolk’s Sudden Attack trait.)

traits.name: Cosmic Musician
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Performance skill and gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice. (This trait replaces the base ravenfolk’s Trickster trait.)

traits.name: Sublime Chord
traits.description: As an action, you can mimic the mysterious sublime song to charm creatures within range. All creatures within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by you for 10 minutes. The charmed creatures regard you as a casual friend. A creature makes this saving throw with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. (This replaces the base ravenfolk’s Mimicry trait.)

description: Sublime ravenfolk are a subrace of ravenfolk, drawn by a mysterious psychic song to the Shadow Realm, and are slighter and shorter than humans, ranging from 4 feet to just shy of 6 feet tall.

Constant Tune.notes: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

tool_profs: one musical instrument of your choice

Sublime Chord.notes: As an action, can charm creatures within 30 ft (DC 13 Cha save, advantage if fighting). Charmed for 10 min, regards you as casual friend. Recharges on long rest.

name: Unbound Satarre

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1. (This trait replaces the base satarre's Ability Score Increase trait.)

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Satarre grow quickly, walking soon after hatching and reaching the development of a 15-year‑old human by age 6. They maintain the same appearance until about 50 and then begin a rapid decline. Satarre often die violently, but those who live longer survive to no more than 65 years of age.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Satarre are born with a tendency toward evil akin to that of rapacious dragons, and when raised among other satarre or darakhul, they are usually evil. Those raised among other cultures tend toward the norm for those cultures.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Satarre are tall and thin, from 6 to 7 feet tall with peculiar, segmented limbs. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your dark planar parentage, you have superior vision in darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keeper of Secrets
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Arcana skill, and you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to the planes and planar travel. In addition, you have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: History, Insight, or Religion.

traits.name: Portal Sense
traits.description: While in a confined space, you instinctively know the direction and distance to the closest nonmagical entrance or exit to the area you are currently in. You also have advantage on any Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) ability checks made to find secret or invisible doors and magical portals. (This trait replaces the base satarre's A Friend of Death trait.)

traits.name: Unraveling Touch
traits.description: You can use your action to attempt to tear at the reality that keeps a being together. Choose a creature that you can see within 30 feet. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature that fails the saving throw must use its action each turn to repeat the saving throw as it attempts to keep itself in one piece. On a successful save, the effect ends on the target. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest. (This trait replaces the base satarre's Carrier of Rot trait.)

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Umbral and either Abyssal, Infernal, or Void Speech.

description: Unbound satarre are a subrace of satarre, planar travelers with an instinctual sensitivity to places of transition, compelled to find gateways and widen their influence through mundane or magical means.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Constitution score increases by 2, Wisdom score increases by 1.

Keeper of Secrets.notes: Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to planes and planar travel. Also gain proficiency in one of History, Insight, or Religion (choice not specified here).

Portal Sense.notes: In a confined space, knows direction and distance to closest nonmagical entrance/exit. Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) checks to find secret/invisible doors and magical portals.

Unraveling Touch.notes: Action: target within 30 ft must make Constitution save (DC 8 + Con mod + prof bonus). On fail, target must use action each turn to repeat save; effect ends on success. Recharges on long rest.

Languages.notes: Speak, read, write Umbral and one of Abyssal, Infernal, or Void Speech.

name: Wyrd Gnome

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Natural Diviner
traits.description: You have an innate knack for understanding the world and can catch glimpses of the mysteries of the universe. You know the guidance cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the identify spell with this trait, requiring no material components, and starting at 5th level, you can cast the augury spell with it. Once you cast a non-cantrip spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

traits.name: Prescience
traits.description: When you finish a long rest, roll a d20 and record the number rolled. Before your next long rest, you can replace one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by you or a creature that you can see with this prescience roll. You must choose to do so before the roll. If 20 wyrd gnomes are present within a half mile of you when you make the prescience roll, you can add 1 to the result. Every time the number of nearby wyrd gnomes is doubled, you gain an additional bonus of 1 to the roll (+2 for 40 gnomes, +3 for 80, and so on) to a maximum bonus of +5.

description: Wyrd gnomes are gnomes with a natural prescience that sets them apart from most other gnomes, often gathering in small communities where their collective prescient power makes them fascinating to visit.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Wisdom score increases by 1.

Natural Diviner.notes: Knows guidance cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast identify (no material components) once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast augury once per long rest. Wisdom is spellcasting ability.

Prescience.notes: After a long rest, roll a d20 and record the number. Before next long rest, can replace one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check (by you or a visible creature) with that prescience roll, chosen before the roll. If 20+ wyrd gnomes are within half a mile, gain +1 to the prescience roll; bonus increases by +1 each time the number of gnomes doubles (max +5).

name: Molefolk

traits.name: Burrow
traits.description: Molefolk cannot burrow into solid rock, but they can move through softer material like soil or loose rubble, leaving a usable tunnel 5 feet in diameter.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The molefolk has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Dirt Dive
traits.description: The molefolk dives into the earth directly below them and can move up to their burrow speed. Moving in this manner does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

description: This small, black-furred humanoid has oversized clawed hands, clamped together in a nervous gesture. His tiny eyes stare at you from behind a pair of thick spectacles positioned on his long pink nose.

Burrow.notes: Can burrow through soil or loose rubble (not solid rock), leaving a usable 5-foot-diameter tunnel.

Keen Smell.notes: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Claws.notes: Natural weapon: Melee Weapon Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.

Dirt Dive.notes: Can dive into earth directly below and move up to burrow speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Aarakocra

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Aarakocra reach maturity by age 3. Compared to humans, aarakocra don't usually live longer than 30 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Most aarakocra are good and rarely choose sides when it comes to law and chaos. Tribal leaders and warriors might be lawful, while explorers and adventurers might tend toward chaotic.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Aarakocra are about 5 feet tall. They have thin, lightweight bodies that weigh between 80 and 100 pounds. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. To use this speed, you can't be wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: You are proficient with your unarmed strikes, which deal 1d4 slashing damage on a hit.

traits.name: Language
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common, Aarakocra, and Auran.

description: Aarakocra are bird-like humanoids about 5 feet tall with thin, lightweight bodies weighing between 80 and 100 pounds, capable of flight.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Dexterity score increases by 2, Wisdom score increases by 1.

Age.notes: Reach maturity by age 3, typically live no longer than 30 years.

Alignment.notes: Most are good, rarely choose sides in law vs chaos.

Flight.notes: Flying speed of 50 feet. Cannot use this speed while wearing medium or heavy armor.

Talons.notes: Proficient with unarmed strikes, which deal 1d4 slashing damage on a hit.

Language.notes: Speak, read, and write Common, Aarakocra, and Auran.

name: Deep Gnome

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

description: Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are small, subterranean gnomes standing about 3 to 3½ feet tall, with a stocky build and skin tones ranging from gray to brown, adapted to life in the Underdark.

Gnome Cunning.notes: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

Stone Camouflage.notes: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

name: Genasi

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Constitution score increases by 2.

traits.name: Age
traits.description: Genasi mature at about the same rate as humans and reach adulthood in their late teens. They live somewhat longer than humans do, up to 120 years.

traits.name: Alignment
traits.description: Independent and self-reliant, genasi tend toward a neutral alignment.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Genasi are as varied as their mortal parents but are generally built like humans, standing anywhere from 5 feet to over 6 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Languages
traits.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Primordial. Primordial is a guttural language, filled with harsh syllables and hard consonants.

traits.name: Subraces
traits.description: Four major subraces of genasi are found among the worlds of D&D: air genasi, earth genasi, fire genasi, and water genasi. Choose one of these subraces.

subraces.name: Air Genasi

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you’re not incapacitated.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You can cast the levitate spell once with this trait, requiring no material components, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

subraces.description: As an air genasi, you are descended from the djinn. As changeable as the weather, your moods shift from calm to wild and violent with little warning, but these storms rarely last long.

subraces.name: Earth Genasi

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Your Strength score increases by 1.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without expending extra movement.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You can cast the pass without trace spell once with this trait, requiring no material components, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

subraces.description: As an earth genasi, you are descended from the cruel and greedy dao, though you aren’t necessarily evil. You have inherited some measure of control over earth, reveling in superior strength and solid power. You tend to avoid rash decisions, pausing long enough to consider your options before taking action.

subraces.name: Fire Genasi
subraces.description: As a fire genasi, you have inherited the volatile mood and keen mind of the efreet. You tend toward impatience and making snap judgments. Rather than hide your distinctive appearance, you exult in it.

description: Genasi are as varied as their mortal parents but are generally built like humans, standing anywhere from 5 feet to over 6 feet tall. They have elemental heritage, with appearances varying by subrace—air genasi often have light blue skin and hair, earth genasi may have dust or gem-like skin, fire genasi have fiery red or coal-black skin, and water genasi have blue or green skin with beads of moisture.

Ability Score Increase.notes: Constitution score increases by 2

name: Goliath

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can focus yourself to occasionally shrug off injury. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled, and reduce the damage by that total. After you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You have resistance to cold damage. You're also acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

description: Goliaths are between 7 and 8 feet tall and weigh between 280 and 340 pounds. They have a strong lawful bent and a sense of fairness balanced with self-sufficiency.

Stone's Endurance.notes: Reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier, usable once per short or long rest.

Powerful Build.notes: Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and push/drag/lift weight.

Mountain Born.notes: Acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

name: Fire Genasi

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Your ties to the Elemental Plane of Fire make your darkvision unusual: everything you see in darkness is in a shade of red.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the produce flame cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell once with this trait as a 1st-level spell, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Nearly all fire genasi are feverishly hot as if burning inside, an impression reinforced by flaming red, coal-black, or ash-gray skin tones. The more human-looking have fiery red hair that writhes under extreme emotion, while more exotic specimens sport actual flames dancing on their heads.

Darkvision.notes: Darkvision sees in shades of red.

Reach to the Blaze.notes: Knows produce flame cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast burning hands once per long rest. Spellcasting ability is Constitution.

name: Water Genasi

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know the shape water cantrip (see chapter 2). When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the create or destroy water spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait, and you regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a long rest. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

description: Most water genasi look as if they just finished bathing, with beads of moisture collecting on their skin and hair. They smell of fresh rain and clean water. Blue or green skin is common, and most have somewhat overlarge eyes, blue-black in color.

Call to the Wave.notes: Knows the shape water cantrip. At 3rd level, can cast create or destroy water (2nd-level) once per long rest. Constitution is spellcasting ability.

name: Silvan Elf Sentinel

traits.name: Disabling Strike
traits.description: By spending a Focus point, the Sentinel can force a target that they has struck to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Stunned until the end of the Sentinel’s next turn.

traits.name: Focused
traits.description: The Sentinel has trained for centuries. They have 5 Focus points, which they regain when they finish a short or long rest. The Sentinel can use their bonus action and spend one Focus point on their turn to take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action, to make an attack with their great spear, or attempt a Disabling Strike.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.description: The Sentinel makes two attacks with either their Great Spear or Great Bow.

traits.name: Great Spear
traits.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) piercing damage.

traits.name: Great Bow
traits.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage

traits.name: Parry
traits.description: The Sentinel adds 3 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them. To do so, the Sentinel must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

description: A Silvan Elf Sentinel is a medium elf guardian, trained for centuries, with a focus on combat and disabling strikes.

Disabling Strike.notes: Can force a target struck to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become Stunned until the end of the Sentinel's next turn. Requires spending a Focus point.

Focused.notes: Has 5 Focus points regained on short or long rest. Can spend 1 Focus point as a bonus action to take Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action, make an attack with great spear, or attempt a Disabling Strike.

Multiattack.notes: Can make two attacks with either Great Spear or Great Bow.

Great Spear.notes: Melee weapon attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) piercing damage.

Great Bow.notes: Ranged weapon attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft, one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) piercing damage.

Parry.notes: Adds 3 to AC against one melee attack that would hit them. Must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Centaur

traits.name: Fey
traits.description: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

traits.name: Hooves
traits.description: Your hooves are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Equine Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

traits.name: Survivor
traits.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

description: Centaurs stand between 6 and 7 feet tall, with their equine bodies reaching about 4 feet at the withers. They are of fey origin and are smaller than the non-fey centaurs that roam in some realms.

Fey.notes: Your creature type is fey, rather than humanoid.

Charge.notes: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

Hooves.notes: Your hooves are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

Equine Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

Survivor.notes: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

name: Goblin

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

description: Goblins are between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh between 40 and 80 pounds. They have an outrageous sense of humor, usually expressed through mischievous pranks.

Fury of the Small.notes: When you damage a creature with an attack or spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage equal to your level. Once used, cannot be used again until finishing a short or long rest.

Nimble Escape.notes: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Loxodon

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Loxodon Serenity
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have thick, leathery skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Trunk
traits.description: You can grasp things with your trunk, and you can use it as a snorkel. It has a reach of 5 feet, and it can lift a number of pounds equal to five times your Strength score. You can use it to do the following simple tasks: lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature; open or close a door or a container; grapple someone; or make an unarmed strike. Your DM might allow other simple tasks to be added to that list of options. Your trunk can't wield weapons or shields or do anything that requires manual precision, such as using tools or magic items or performing the somatic components of a spell.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Thanks to your sensitive trunk, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), and Intelligence (Investigation) checks that involve smell.

description: Loxodons are massive, elephant-like humanoids standing between 7 and 8 feet tall, with thick, leathery skin and a prehensile trunk.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Trunk.notes: You can grasp things with your trunk, and you can use it as a snorkel. It has a reach of 5 feet, and it can lift a number of pounds equal to five times your Strength score. You can use it to do the following simple tasks: lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature; open or close a door or a container; grapple someone; or make an unarmed strike. Your DM might allow other simple tasks to be added to that list of options. Your trunk can't wield weapons or shields or do anything that requires manual precision, such as using tools or magic items or performing the somatic components of a spell.

Keen Smell.notes: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), and Intelligence (Investigation) checks that involve smell.

name: Minotaur

traits.name: Horns
traits.description: Your horns are natural melee weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.description: Immediately after you use the Dash action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action.

traits.name: Hammering Horns
traits.description: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that target with your horns. The target must be no more than one size larger than you and within 5 feet of you. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier, you push it up to 10 feet away from you.

traits.name: Imposing Presence
traits.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Intimidation or Persuasion.

description: Minotaurs average over 6 feet in height, and they have stocky builds.

Horns.notes: Your horns are natural melee weapons. You can use them to make unarmed strikes that deal 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage.

Goring Rush.notes: Immediately after you use the Dash action and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action.

Hammering Horns.notes: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove that target with your horns. The target must be no more than one size larger than you and within 5 feet. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier), you push it up to 10 feet away.

Imposing Presence.notes: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Intimidation or Persuasion.

name: Simic Hybrid
languages: Elvish (or another language of your choice)

traits.name: Animal Enhancements
traits.description:
Your body has been altered to incorporate certain animal characteristics. You choose one of the following options when you create your character, and you can't change it later. 

**Manta Glide.** You have gliding membranes like a manta ray. You have a flying speed of 30 feet when you aren't wearing heavy armor. This speed is reduced by 10 feet if you are carrying 100 pounds or more. 

**Nimble Climber.** You have a climbing speed of 30 feet. 

**Underwater Adaptation.** You have a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

traits.name: Variable Adaptation
traits.description:
When you reach 5th level, you can choose one of the following options, which represents a further adaptation to your environment. You can't change this later. 

**Gills.** You can breathe underwater. 

**Grappling Appendage.** You have a special appendage that you can use to grapple creatures. It's a natural melee weapon with which you are proficient. If you hit a creature with it, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, and it is grappled (escape DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier). This appendage can't be used to make attacks against a creature you have grappled, but you can release it as a free action. 

**Reactive Carapace.** When you take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

description: Simic Hybrids are humanoid soldiers created by the Simic Combine's Guardian Project, transformed from human, vedalken, and elf volunteers to defend the guild.

Animal Enhancements.notes: Choose one option at character creation: Manta Glide (flying speed 30 ft when not wearing heavy armor, reduced by 10 ft if carrying 100+ lbs), Nimble Climber (climbing speed 30 ft), or Underwater Adaptation (swimming speed 30 ft, can breathe underwater).

Variable Adaptation.notes: At 5th level, choose one: Gills (breathe underwater), Grappling Appendage (natural melee weapon, 1d6+Str bludgeoning, grapples on hit, escape DC 8+prof+Str), or Reactive Carapace (reaction to gain resistance to damage taken, recharges on short/long rest).

name: Vedalken
languages: one other language of your choice

traits.name: Vedalken Dispassion
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Tireless Precision
traits.description: You are proficient in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Performance, or Sleight of Hand.
